name: The Police

whyMatters.en: London trio that fused reggae upstrokes, new-wave tightness, and pop melody into early-1980s global rock radio.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦三人组：把雷鬼上击、new wave 紧凑与流行旋律融进 1980 年代初全球摇滚电台。

note.en: Reggae upstroke + white-reggae club tension as debut hit.
note.zh: 雷鬼上击 + 白雷鬼俱乐部张力作为出道热单。

note.en: Summers delay/chorus figure as trio signature.
note.zh: Summers 的延时/chorus 音型成为三人组签名。

note.en: Synchronicity ballad; Copeland restraint under stalker lyric.
note.zh: Synchronicity 谣曲；跟踪狂歌词下 Copeland 的克制。

interviewQuotes.text: We were a trio. That was the discipline.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Stewart Copeland

lyricQuotes: Roxanne, you don't have to put on the red light
Every breath you take, every move you make

shortBio.en: Sting / Summers / Copeland; Every Breath You Take is the mass ballad.
shortBio.zh: Sting / Summers / Copeland；Every Breath You Take 是大众谣曲。

body.en:
Formed 1977. Outlandos d’Amour through Synchronicity track rising scale: Copeland’s hi-hat reggae grammar, Summers’s chorus/delay angles, Sting’s high melodic bass and vocal.

Roxanne (1978) and Every Breath You Take (1983) bookend club tension and global pop. They show post-punk energy can chart without punk orthodoxy or soft-rock surrender.
body.zh:
1977 年组建。从 Outlandos d’Amour 到 Synchronicity 追踪体量上升：Copeland 的踩镲雷鬼语法、Summers 的 chorus/延时棱角、Sting 的高音旋律贝斯与人声。

Roxanne（1978）与 Every Breath You Take（1983）标记俱乐部张力与全球流行两端。证明后朋克能量可以上榜，无需朋克正统，也不向软摇滚投降。

title.zh: new wave 流行里的雷鬼语法

body.en:
The Police shrink rock to a trio and borrow reggae upstrokes without becoming a reggae band. Copeland’s hi-hat and offbeat kick, Summers’s chorus/delay chords, Sting’s high bass+vocal—one interlocking clock.

Post-punk energy that charts: tight, melodic, not three-chord orthodoxy.
body.zh:
The Police 把摇滚缩成三人组，借用雷鬼上击却不变成雷鬼乐队。Copeland 的踩镲与反拍底鼓、Summers 的 chorus/延时和弦、Sting 的高音贝斯+人声——一套咬合时钟。

能上榜的后朋克能量：紧、有旋律，不是三和弦正统。

title.zh: 一套三人组，然后各自离开

body.en:
1977–86 is essentially one cast. Internal tension (especially Sting vs Copeland) ends the run after Synchronicity. Later reunion tours replay the hits; the chronicle’s peak version remains the original trio.

No classic-lineup churn—just an abrupt stop.
body.zh:
1977–86 基本是一套人马。内部张力（尤其 Sting vs Copeland）在 Synchronicity 后结束运行。后来重聚巡演重播热歌；编年史巅峰版本仍是原三人组。

没有经典阵容更替——只有突然停机。

title.zh: 贝斯/人声、chorus 吉他、雷鬼鼓

body.en:
Sting writes most melodies and plays melodic bass high in the mix. Summers paints with effects rather than metal leads. Copeland treats the kit like a percussion ensemble—octobans, hi-hat chatter.

Three egos, one clock: the songs work when the grid locks.
body.zh:
Sting 写大部分旋律，并把旋律贝斯推到混音高处。Summers 用效果器上色，而不是金属主音。Copeland 把鼓组当打击乐合奏——八角鼓、踩镲碎语。

三个自我、一套时钟：格子锁住时歌才成立。

title.zh: Roxanne：俱乐部热单，白雷鬼框架

body.en:
Debut-era single: sparse arrangement, Sting’s nasal lead, Copeland’s upstroke-friendly groove. Proves the trio format can compete on punk-adjacent radio without leather orthodoxy.

Entry object for the whole catalog.
body.zh:
出道期单曲：编配稀疏、Sting 鼻音主唱、Copeland 适合上击的律动。证明三人编制能在朋克相邻电台竞争，无需皮衣正统。

整本目录的入口对象。

title.en: Every Breath You Take: ballad as trap
title.zh: Every Breath You Take：当陷阱的谣曲

body.en:
Synchronicity (1983) global ballad. Summers’s clean arpeggio, Copeland’s restrained kit, Sting’s stalker lyric often misheard as romance.

Peak chart proof that the trio’s discipline scales to soft dynamics without soft-rock surrender.
body.zh:
Synchronicity（1983）全球谣曲。Summers 干净分解和弦、Copeland 克制鼓组、Sting 的跟踪狂歌词常被听成浪漫。

榜单峰值证明：三人组纪律可以放到轻动态，却不向软摇滚投降。

title.zh: 朋克之后的三人流行摇滚语法

body.en:
Later radio rock (Killers, Coldplay-adjacent dynamics) cites the melodic bass + effects guitar + tight drums recipe. Sting’s solo career splits the brand; the Police catalog stays the locked-trio document.

Short discography, long citation list for post-punk that charts.
body.zh:
后来的电台摇滚（Killers、Coldplay 相邻动态）引用「旋律贝斯 + 效果吉他 + 紧鼓」配方。Sting 独唱拆开品牌；Police 目录仍是锁定三人组的文献。

作品目录短；对能上榜的后朋克引用列表长。

note.en: Only studio/live peak cast; reunions replay this silhouette.
note.zh: 唯一录音室/现场巅峰卡司；重聚重播这一剪影。

note.en: Reggae-upstroke new wave as chart punk-adjacent hit.
note.zh: 雷鬼上击 new wave 作为朋克相邻榜单热单。

note.en: Trio reggae/new-wave grammar that scaled to global ballads.
note.zh: 可放大到全球谣曲的三人雷鬼/new wave 语法。
